_help: Routing rules. Each rule: match = regex (case-insensitive, searched in your message); then one or more of force = tiny|everyday|large|hardest|here (skip Jev, use this tier; 'here' = stay in this session), min = never go below this tier, max = never go above this tier (only applied when Jev is sure). note = the label shown in the status line. A leading @tag in the message beats every rule. Test a message offline with the CLI: check "your message"
